summary: List the public evidence signing key of a third trusted build host under an invented host name

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; this lists one public key in a trust file.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes. The skip policy already admits the host level for the wrapper kind on pull_request runs; this key adds one signer it counts. The merge queue never skips on it.

compatibility.detail: No command, frame, scope or stored-format change in the product.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator action is required by this change. The owner of the host keeps its signer configuration matching the listed name.

recovery.detail: No persistent product state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
